notes.title: Trivia Night 0.2 Update Released! New Game Modes, Turkish Language and more!
notes.content:
http://i68.tinypic.com/f0tdw5.png

What's New


Math game mode!
Words game mode! (Online)
Language screen and Turkish language.
New questions added.


Bug Fixes


Red screen problem fixed.
Fun with flags menu button fixed.


Changes

Game architecture set to 64bit.
Some answers changed.
Menu UI color changed.
Answer button color changed.
Few sound changes.
Few typo fixes.
Removed fun with flags score limit.

notes.title: Early Access Notes - Week 1
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/GsBcZjc.png

Hello everyone! Thank you all for interest in our first week. We're following your comments, feedbacks. You should know we're indie developers and Trivia Night is in Early Access Alpha right now.

But you can be sure we're planning new modes, more features and hours of fun gameplay!

Working On


   Localization (New Languages)
   Info Button: The button that says why it is the answer.
   Guess The Food
   Trade Cards
   Online Multiplayer
   More Questions & Mods
   Categories



Thanks for your support,
TRIVIA NIGHT
